messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: CRITICAL - inference-queue-backlog (service: inference-hotpath). threshold=queue_depth>1200 for 3m. PD incident: PD123456. auto-page=on :rotating_light:
pd-bot: PagerDuty page fired to: @jamie_ops, @maria_oncall, @sre_lead_kim. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD123456
jamie_ops: acked PD123456 :thumbsup: I'm on it, joining the channel
maria_oncall: seeing a bunch of 503s in frontend logs, customer spike? ingress shows steady RPS but backend worker throughput dropping.
sre_lead_kim: checking autoscaler metrics now — looks like scale-controller is trying to create nodes but cloud API is returning quota error: "RESOURCE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Insufficient CPUs in region us-west-2". Pods pending -> scheduler backoff.
platform-eng-raj: confirmed from provider console: account limit hit on vCPU family used for our inference pool. Auto-request for quota increase is pending but not instant.
jamie_ops: that would explain failing pod provisioning. Queue backlog is growing because new workers can't come up to consume KV-cache warmups. Estimated backlog 1.3k items, avg latency 7s, 99th=18s.
cs-liz: FYI customers on trial clusters are reporting timeouts; support ticket #7892 flagged customer-impact for two enterprise tenants. Need an ETA for mitigation.
maria_oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) Shift traffic to dedicated pool (smaller model footprints) 2) Manual horizontal pod eviction+reschedule on existing nodes to rebalance 3) Spin up spare smaller instance types that are within quota. Thoughts?
sre_lead_kim: prefer (3) + (1) as quick path: provision smaller shape instances using our spare quota in a different vCPU family (us-west-2a). I can run the provisioning script.
platform-eng-raj: I can approve using spare repo credentials for a different instance family, but need a quick config patch. Command I will run next: ```./infractl provision --region us-west-2 --flavor c6i-medium --count 10 --pool inference-hotpath-fallback```
jamie_ops: I'll update routing rule to allow fallback pool for low-priority requests: `rctl set-route inference-hotpath --fallback-pool inference-hotpath-fallback --threshold 80%` — doing a dry-run first.
maria_oncall: while that happens, start reducing batch sizes to lower memory pressure on existing workers: `redwoodctl set-config inference-hotpath --batch-size 1` — will reduce throughput but prevent OOMs.
sre_lead_kim: running provision now, got 10 new instances provisioning. Cloud console shows 6/10 active after 90s.
incident-bot: Note: manual change recorded in deploy log (user=kim).
jamie_ops: routing update applied, fallback enabled for non-SLA routes. Traffic shifted ~30% to fallback pool. Queue drain rate improving.
cs-liz: told affected customers we're investigating and implemented temporary mitigations; offering priority escalation to dedicated nodes where needed.
pd-bot: PD123456 acknowledged by jamie_ops at 4309991240. Escalation timer paused.
maria_oncall: batch-size reduction + fallback pool raised consumption enough to push backlog down from 1300 -> 420 in 6m. 503s reduced by ~78%. Still monitoring KV cache warmup tail which is slower on fallback.
platform-eng-raj: quota increase request still pending with provider (case #Q-998877). We should file for long-term quota bump and update autoscaler to prefer different families when quota errors occur.
sre_lead_kim: agreed — follow-up action items: 1) permanent quota increase request + owner 2) autoscaler enhancement: detect quota errors and use fallback flavors 3) add runbook step to shift traffic to dedicated pool 4) notify customers update. I'll create a GH issue and link here.
jamie_ops: handing off to @maria_oncall for the next 2hr watch. Maria, take ownership of PD123456 and update status every 15m. I'm logging the manual commands in incident timeline.
maria_oncall: taking over. I'll monitor backlog until <100 and then step down. Thanks all. :heart:
incident-bot: Incident PD123456 status: acknowledged -> in-progress. Severity: P1.
pd-bot: PD123456 status updated to Andon: in-progress (owner: maria_oncall).
maria_oncall: final note for the thread: performance improved but still risk if another burst arrives before quota bump. Follow-up GH: redwood/inference#7421 "Autoscaler: graceful fallback to alternate instance families on quota errors" assigned to platform-eng-raj. I'll update CS with ETA for permanent fix.
